**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **§ 4.1 Charges (p0052)** ties all Charges to Services actually specified in Order Forms / Service Option Attachments on a one-time, installment, recurring or usage basis — no minimum, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic anywhere in the Base Terms (searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume" returned nothing relevant).
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142)** only allocates sizing/forecasting responsibility to Customer; it does not commit us to any capacity level or usage volume.
- **§ 3.4 (p0044–p0045)** gives us a convenience exit at the end of any calendar month on one month's notice, so there is no lock-in even if an Order Form were to include a term.

This satisfies the preferred position, so no edit was made. One watch item flagged for the Order Form stage (not a deviation in this document): § 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — those documents are not before us, and we should confirm any such charge is a true-up for services actually ordered rather than a penalty or disguised minimum commitment.
